steps.note: Observe current screen and launch Simple SMS Messenger
Launch Simple SMS Messenger and observe its screen
Tap new conversation FAB and enter recipient number
Type recipient number, then select it and open message screen
Tap confirm to open message screen and type message
Read conversation screen after opening new message
Type message text, then tap SMS send button
Tap SMS send button and verify message appears in thread
Task complete; message sent and verified in thread
